rv.q: Whether this is your first or fifteenth time experiencing WEST SIDE STORY, please do not miss this absolutely extraordinary presentation at Music Theater Works.
They got to see a fine production of one of the best examples of American musical art, and they'll never forget it.

There is oh-so-smart, insightful direction by Sasha Gerritson. Clayton Cross and Isa Ramirez share choreography credit. The intimacy/violence choreographer Nick Sandys created sharp, well-paced gang fights between the Sharks and the Jets, while tenderly and deftly weaving the romantic moments between Maria and Tony.
Why is director Sasha Gerritson's excellent production only running for two and a half weeks? Here's hoping for an extension.
It is a polished production honoring the classic, but leaves one wishing it had pushed a little further.
Music Theater Works captures it beautifully. This is a production filled with soaring music, athletic dancing and youthful passion.
The choreography is 'stunning', the direction allows the story to move quickly, and the love songs between Ruano and Nowakowski were radiant.
Overall, this is an enjoyable, solid production in a great venue with strong musical and dance performances all around.
